name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A vertical sequence of events joined by a connecting line — an audit trail, a delivery history, a changelog. Each node is a marker (dot or icon) with a title, an optional time and body. Presentational; the caller orders the items and formats the times.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/Timeline.json
